description: This file is a Zephyr RTOS application demonstrating GPIO input/output and interrupt handling on the UP Squared board, implementing a GPIO counter with interrupt-driven updates.

methods.name: button_cb
methods.description: Interrupt callback that increments the counter and signals the semaphore.

methods.name: get_gpio_dev
methods.description: Checks if the GPIO device is ready and returns 0 if ready, -1 otherwise.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing GPIO pins, setting up interrupts, and running the GPIO counter loop.
